thread:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — P1: API reachability errors from multiple customers. Observed 502/524 TLS handshake failures at the edge. Impact: API endpoints (api.redwood.ai) intermittently unreachable for regions us-west and eu-west. On-call: alice.k

alice.k: seeing spike in TLS handshake failures from Cloudflare edges. Errors in app logs: `tls: handshake failure` and connection resets. Customers report 5xx when calling /v1/generate and embeddings. Repro from my laptop via curl shows TLS errors. Adding details to INC-2026-034.

bob_sre: joining. Any recent deploys? I don't see deploys around the start time. Checking Cloudflare status now: https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incident/abcdef. They show \"An issue affecting TLS termination in select POPs\".

alice.k: confirmed no deploys. Origin healthy, direct curl to origin IP succeeds with TLS. Example:
``
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health --resolve api.redwood.ai:443:34.200.10.5
* TLS 1.3 handshake completed
* Connected to 34.200.10.5
> GET /v1/health HTTP/1.1
``
But via DNS -> Cloudflare edge fails.

dave-support: Customer impact: Support queue sees ~30 tickets in last 10m, mostly timeouts and 524. Enterprise customers on Dedicated reported errors in EU, requesting status and SLA impact.

bob_sre: hypothesis: Cloudflare edge misconfig for certain POPs causing handshake drop. Short-term mitigation: route traffic around CF by toggling DNS to point to our alternate egress LB hostname (bypass-cf.redwood.ai) which has a higher TTL but is prepped for bypass. We should adjust Route53 weighted record to favor bypass.

alice.k: rolling change to DNS weight now. Lowering TTL not ideal mid-incident but weight change is instant for newly resolved queries. Executing:
``
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://bypass-weight.json
``

infra-eng-bot: change submitted: change-id Z3DM... status PENDING. Estimated propagation within 30s for new queries.

bob_sre: also enabling origin-only CNAME on Cloudflare (\"orange-to-gray\") for api.redwood.ai as a fallback — switching to \"DNS only\" for problematic zones. Doing this for eu-west and us-west zones.

alice.k: making that change in CF dashboard now, will post screenshots.

carol-oncall: taking over next shift at +30m. Any runbooks we should follow during handoff?

alice.k: runbook items: 1) confirm origin health; 2) fail traffic to bypass LB; 3) contact Cloudflare support with tracebacks and SNI examples; 4) update status page and CS.

dave-support: drafted status page update. Please review: \"We are experiencing API reachability issues due to a Cloudflare edge TLS problem affecting select regions. We have failed traffic to an alternate route and are monitoring.\"

bob_sre: also capturing PCAPs and TLS logs. Example client error signature:
``
TLS handshake error: tls: unsupported ssl_version
remote_addr=203.0.113.12:443
``

alice.k: Cloudflare support replied in ticket: \"We're seeing elevated TLS handshake errors on several POPs; engineering is investigating; mitigation is to disable TLS 1.3 earlydata for affected POps.\" They requested a SNI sample and client hello. I uploaded a packet capture.

bob_sre: good. In parallel, we're toggling to bypass LB. Early metrics: 70% of traffic in eu-west now hitting bypass, error p50 dropped from 850ms to 120ms, 5xx down 90%.

dave-support: sending customer comms update. Notifying key enterprises via their dedicated channels.

infra-eng-bot: DNS change propagated. Cloudflare dashboard shows reduced TLS handshake error rate for zones we toggled.

alice.k: starting handoff notes for carol: timeline, what we changed, CF ticket id: 78910, bypass hostname, rollback steps. Leaving monitoring alerts muted for the routing change.

carol-oncall: thanks — I'll own the watch. Next steps: monitor for recurrence, confirm Cloudflare fix before reverting DNS/cname. Please pin CF incident link and ticket.

bob_sre: post-incident actions we should track: add automated fallback to bypass LB in our routing policy, pre-authorize DNS change for quicker execute, improve observability to correlate TLS handshake errors to edge POPs, add synthetic checks that use CF chain and direct origin.

alice.k: agreeing. Also need runbook add: how to gather SNI/client_hello quickly from our ingress fleet and packaging pcap for CF.

dave-support: closing loop with customers: updated all affected tickets with mitigation and ETA for full recovery when Cloudflare confirms.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-034 status: Mitigated — partial traffic bypassed, customer impact reduced. Owner: carol-oncall. Timeline recorded. Please follow up with postmortem within 72h.

carol-oncall: acknowledged. I'll draft the postmortem and include CF timeline, our mitigation, and action items.

alice.k: thanks team. Leaving handoff. :coffee:
